title: Agent Model Policy Overlay v1
description: Operator-editable, validated JSON overlay that selects the Layer-1 agent roster's models: an applied built-in template plus per-agent, per-field overrides. Missing file = library defaults (the 'balanced' template); an invalid file is a loud typed error, never a silent fallback (missing != invalid). One policy governs BOTH L1 projections (.claude/agents/*.md and .codex/agents/*.toml). Hard constraint (G-1/D-7): no combination may resolve claude-fable-5 onto security-reviewer — enforced at template import, store parse, and the panel validate endpoint (semantic checks like registry-known models and known agent names are enforced by the store, beyond this structural schema).

applied_template.description: Id of the built-in template applied as the roster base (e.g. 'balanced', 'subscription-saver', 'max-quality'). Omit to base on the library default ('balanced'). An unknown id is a hard validation error.

overrides.description: Per-agent overrides keyed by agent name (a core agent). Each override layers on top of the applied template per field: model, effort, or both.

model.description: Claude model id from core/model_registry (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5'). Never claude-fable-5 when the agent is security-reviewer (G-1/D-7).

effort.description: Rendered Claude reasoning effort for this agent. The codex model_reasoning_effort derives from it via the fixed clamp map low→low, medium→medium, high→high, xhigh→high, max→high (D-3).
